judgments.description: One judgment per target provision id.

clause_id.description: The provision id exactly as given in the prompt.

prob_cat1.description: Probability of an intrinsic textual defect, in [0,1]. The bound is stated here rather than as minimum/maximum: the structured-output dialect rejects numeric range keywords, and the reader clamps.

prob_cat2.description: Probability of a defect relative to the rest of the instrument, in [0,1]. Bound stated here for the same reason as prob_cat1.

reasoning_cat1.description: The provision's own wording only; justifies prob_cat1.

reasoning_cat2.description: The provision's fit with the rest of the instrument only; justifies prob_cat2.
